optimizedDescription.value: Defines hook types, dispatch, phase ordering, failures, manual skipping, and safe variable expansion across lifecycle operations.

optimizedContext.value:
# Hook Execution Model
## Rules
- Workflow entries declare `id` plus one payload: `instruction:`, shell `run:`, or `external: { type, config }`; schema validation rejects invalid payload combinations. Every workflow step may declare all hook kinds.
- `instruction:` is passive text, consumed only by `GetHookInstructions` for step+phase and optional hook ID. Never process-executed; no exit code, output, side effects. `TransitionChange`, `ArchiveChange`, `RunStepHooks` skip it. `CompileContext` excludes it.
- `run:` is executed only by `HookRunner`; never injected into agent context.
- External hooks dispatch to registered external runner supporting `external.type`. No accepting runner MUST fail clearly. `HookRunner` remains shell-only.
- `TransitionChange` and `ArchiveChange` auto-execute operational hooks through `RunStepHooks`. `Change` entity MUST NOT execute hooks.
- `TransitionChange`: target-step pre-hooks before state change; post-hooks afterward. `ArchiveChange`: pre-hooks before any file mutation; post-hooks after completion.
- Pre-phase is fail-fast: first non-zero `run:` or failed external hook stops remaining hooks. `TransitionChange` throws `HookFailedError` without transition; `ArchiveChange` throws before file changes; standalone `RunStepHooks` returns failure and CLI exits 2.
- Post-phase is fail-soft: completed transition/archive is never rolled back; all hooks continue; failures collected in `postHookFailures`. Standalone CLI exits 2 if any failed.
- Phase order: schema-level hooks in declaration order, then matching project `schemaOverrides` hooks in declaration order.
- Manual control uses `skipHookPhases`. `TransitionChange`: `source.pre`, `source.post`, `target.pre`, `target.post`, `all`. `ArchiveChange`: `pre`, `post`, `all`. CLI `--skip-hooks` maps to selectors.
- Manual sequence: read `specd change hook-instruction`; execute `specd change run-hooks`; invoke lifecycle command with skipped auto-phases; execute post hooks; read post instructions.
- Before shell execution, `HookRunner` expands `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.path}}`, `{{project.root}}` and shell-escapes substitutions. Unknown paths remain unchanged. `{{change.workspace}}` MUST NOT exist; derive touched workspaces from `specIds`.

## Constraints
- `RunStepHooks` single execution engine for use cases and CLI.
- Pre-hooks always fail-fast; post-hooks always fail-soft.
- Schema hooks always precede project hooks per phase.
- External backend differs from shell backend; lifecycle phase semantics identical.
- Variable expansion and shell escaping belong to `HookRunner`, never callers.
